source_atoms.proposition: Three selected public hasDecorator/hasRequestDecorator/hasReplyDecorator declarations require a decoration argument of string | symbol, not an optional argument.
Exports map existRequest and existReply to their selected normal-function wrappers.
Request wrapper retains a plain checkExistence(this[kRequest].prototype, name) call after two name-guarded early checks.
Reply wrapper retains a plain checkExistence(this[kReply].prototype, name) call after two name-guarded early checks.
For falsy name the selected helper evaluates instance in this; the file begins use strict.
kRequest and kReply are internal Symbol-valued keys, distinct from the explicit decoration argument.
The selected strict normal helper plain call does not inherit the outer wrapper receiver; reaching its falsy branch with undefined this would fail the in-operator object-right-operand requirement.
The truthy-name helper branch uses membership checks on explicit instance/prototype and hasKey, so the conditional falsy-path explanation is not a claim that all lookups throw.
